t: Paul Shenar
s: Albert Paul Shenar (February 12, 1936 – October 11, 1989) was an American character actor and theater director renowned for his resonant voice and commanding presence in both stage and screen roles. Best known for portraying the composed yet ruthless Bolivian drug lord Alejandro Sosa in Brian De Palma's Scarface (1983) and voicing the scheming rat Jenner in Don Bluth's animated film The Secret of NIMH (1982), Shenar brought a distinctive gravitas to antagonistic characters.
